<div class="card-body">
'''Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ガベージ・シュートに飛び込んで！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「ゴミ圧縮装置」のカードが場にでないと使えない。デス・スターの他の位置で戦闘が宣言された時に使う。その位置にいる自分のキャラクターを全員、コストなしで「ゴミ圧縮装置」に移動し、戦闘をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-89o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">レイアは、デス・スターの監房ブロックからガベージ・シュートへと、前代未聞の脱出を先導した。「かわいい香りとはおよそほど遠いぜ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jump Into the Garbage Chute!

'''Card text:''' May not be used unless Trash Compactor is on table. Use when a battle is declared at another Death Star site. Move all of your characters at that site to Trash Compactor for free and cancel the battle.

'''Lore:''' Leia led an unprecedented escape from the Death Star detention block into a garbage chute. “That’s about as far from a sweet smell as you can get!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese moves all of your characters at that site; the English moves all your characters involved.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
